name: Park Hyatt Hyderabad
positioning: City hotel in Banjara Hills, Hyderabad, with an art walkway, serviced apartments and Italian and Asian restaurants
best_for: Travelers who want a Banjara Hills base with a pool, spa and several restaurants
Longer stays and pet owners who want a serviced apartment with a full kitchen
Weddings and events in a pillarless ballroom or the residential-style Manor

facts.text: The hotel is on Road No. 2 in Banjara Hills, Hyderabad.
Jubilee Hills and Banjara Hills are less than 10 minutes from the hotel.
The hotel suggests visiting the 16th-century Golconda Fort and the Qutub Shahi tombs.
Guest rooms have a marble bathroom with a walk-in rain shower and a soaking tub.
Apartments have a fully equipped kitchen with a microwave and dishwasher.
Tre-Forni serves Northern Italian cooking, including rustic pastas and wood-fired pizzas.
Rika serves sushi, dim sum and Teppan dishes by day.
The Living Room lounge serves afternoon tea.
The outdoor pool is temperature-controlled and has cabanas.
The fitness centre is on the mezzanine and overlooks the pool.
The hotel has a pillarless ballroom for weddings.

highlights.text: An Art Walkway on the lobby level displays a collection of paintings and sculptures.
The spa is inspired by the wellness traditions of the Nizams, combined with modern therapeutic techniques.
The hotel offers fully serviced, pet-friendly apartments.
Tre-Forni has a wine list of over 1,000 bottles.
By night, Rika After Dark becomes a social venue with cocktails and music.

considerations.text: Rajiv Gandhi International Airport is 35.6 kilometers from the hotel.
For sustainability, certain room amenities are discontinued or only available on request.
WhataHotel notes a business-focused atmosphere that may feel formal for leisure travelers.
